title: Results for every request
hints: First start every fetch and keep the futures (each with a `handle` that turns failures into text); only then combine them with `allOf` (lesson 8.02).

`handle((value, error) -> ...)` always runs; unwrap a `CompletionException` with `getCause()` to reach the real error. When `fetch.apply(id)` throws, catch the exception and use `CompletableFuture.failedFuture(e)`, a future that has already failed with `e`, so it is handled like the others.
